crossRefs.note: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,
he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,
Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain, yet his foolishness will not be removed from him.
This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all: yes also, the heart of the sons of…
Why should you be beaten more, that you revolt more and more? The whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
For my hand has made all these things, and so all these things came to be,” says Yahweh: “but I will look to this man…
All these servants of yours will come down to me, and bow down themselves to me, saying, “Get out, with all the people…
Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, please don’t count this sin against us, in which we have done foolishly, and in…
The king answered the man of God, “Now intercede for the favor of Yahweh your God, and pray for me, that my hand may be…
The sons of those who afflicted you will come bowing to you; and all those who despised you will bow themselves down at…
Behold, I give some of the synagogue of Satan, of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but lie—behold, I will…
He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

translations.web: Again he sent the captain of a third fifty with his fifty. The third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and begged him, and said to him, “Man of God, please let my life, and the life of these fifty of your servants, be precious in your sight.
translations.bsb: So the king sent a third captain with his fifty men. And the third captain went up, fell on his knees before Elijah, and begged him, “Man of God, may my life and the lives of these fifty servants of yours please be precious in your sight.
translations.kjv: And he sent again a captain of the third fifty with his fifty. And the third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and besought him, and said unto him, O man of God, I pray thee, let my life, and the life of these fifty thy servants, be precious in thy sight.
translations.asv: And again he sent the captain of a third fifty with his fifty.
